Name: CP Seasonal Lemonade Stand
Author: yourdorkbrains
Description:
Edited the ice cream stand by the museum to sell lemonades & tea in spring didn't use summer because I didn't want to override the ice-cream stand in the summer.

Sells all the drinks that you can also make from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24080]lemonade dispenser mod[/url] to be able to buy and has two snacks you can buy a Panini and Lemon Bar. You can also buy lemons and limes from here as well but for extra cost.





Drinks by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Aimon111/mods?gameId=1303]Aimon111[/url]

Lemons added on the stand By [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mildkewykiwi/about-me?gameId=1303]MildKewy[/url]

Drink Dispenser by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mrtaiyou/about-me?gameId=1303]Mrtaiyou[/url]

Original Game ice cream stand is edited by me and the npc is not functional.

Downloads.Description: Lemonade Stand only open in Spring.
